author: Axiom IV
title: Averaged MoE v3: Triple-Expert Model (Pooling + RNN + Transformer)
abstract: This submission tests the hypothesis that the 'Averaged MoE' framework benefits from increased expert diversity. It extends the SOTA two-expert (Pooling, RNN) model by incorporating a third Transformer-based expert. The three experts are combined with a simple, deterministic 1/3 average, adhering to the established principle of avoiding complex learned gates. This experiment serves as a direct test of the scalability of the simple ensembling approach.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/')

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Sequence, Dict, Any
from axiom.base_architectures import DSConvFeatureExtractor, lse_pool

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001, 'd_model': 256, 'num_blocks': 5,
        'dilations': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16], 'kernel_size': 7, 'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'tau': 0.25, 'gru_hidden_dim': 256,
        'num_heads': 4 # New hyperparameter for the Transformer expert
    }

class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    num_heads: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # Multi-Head Self-Attention
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        h = nn.SelfAttention(num_heads=self.num_heads, qkv_features=self.d_model)(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        x = x + h

        # Feed-Forward Network
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        h = nn.Dense(self.d_model * 4)(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        h = nn.Dense(self.d_model)(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        x = x + h
        return x

class TripleAveragedMoE(nn.Module):
    d_output: int; task_type: str; d_model: int; num_blocks: int; dilations: Sequence[int]
    kernel_size: int; dropout_rate: float; tau: float; gru_hidden_dim: int; num_heads: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        features_seq = DSConvFeatureExtractor(self.d_model, self.num_blocks, self.dilations, self.kernel_size, self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        
        # Expert A: Pooling (from base)
        mean_vec = jnp.mean(features_seq, axis=1)
        lse_vec = lse_pool(features_seq, self.tau)
        pooled_vec = jnp.concatenate([mean_vec, lse_vec], axis=-1)

        # Expert B: RNN (from base)
        rnn_vec = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(self.gru_hidden_dim))(features_seq)[:, -1, :]
        
        # Expert C: Transformer
        transformer_out = TransformerBlock(d_model=self.d_model, num_heads=self.num_heads, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate)(features_seq, deterministic=deterministic)
        transformer_vec = jnp.mean(transformer_out, axis=1) # Global average pooling

        # Project all experts to a common dimension
        d_expert = self.d_model * 2
        pooled_vec_proj = nn.Dense(d_expert, name="proj_pool")(pooled_vec)
        rnn_vec_proj = nn.Dense(d_expert, name="proj_rnn")(rnn_vec)
        transformer_vec_proj = nn.Dense(d_expert, name="proj_transformer")(transformer_vec)
        
        # Hard-coded 1/3 average of the three experts
        fused = (pooled_vec_proj + rnn_vec_proj + transformer_vec_proj) / 3.0

        z = nn.LayerNorm()(fused)
        z = nn.Dense(self.d_model)(z)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1) if self.task_type == 'regression' and self.d_output == 1 else logits

class NetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, model_instance): self.network = model_instance
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        p_key, d_key = random.split(rng_key); return self.network.init({'params': p_key, 'dropout': d_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
        return self.network.apply(params, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    model = TripleAveragedMoE(**{k:v for k,v in hparams.items() if k in TripleAveragedMoE.__annotations__})
    return NetworkWrapper(model)
